versions.content: The transmitter of an Offset Time Base (Time Master) shall perform the following steps to distribute the Offset Time Base: 1. Retrieve current Offset Time via StbM_GetOffset 2. Write second portion of the Offset Time to OfsTimeSec 3. Write nanosecond portion of the Offset Time to OfsTimeNSec 28 of 71 Document ID 675: AUTOSAR_SWS_TimeSyncOverFlexRay Specification of Time Synchronization over FlexRay AUTOSAR CP R21-11
